title: Single Cell Dissociation of Small Tumor Biopsies
author: Ashley Maynard
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.65rhg56
materials: OPTIONAL: If there are persistent chucks of tissue that did not pass though the filter, gather them into a new 1.5 mL tube and add 0.5 mL 0.05% warmed trypsin. Digest the tissue for 00:10:00 at 37 °C , shaking in a thermomixer @ 800-1000 rpm. Quench the reaction with 1 mL Base Buffer. Filter the sample over a 100-micron filter into a new 1.5 mL tube. Wash filter with 1-2 mL of collagenase buffer. Check cells with Trypan Blue and Hemocytometer, take picture on microscope and label with date and sample ID and record # of live/dead cells. Combine the filtered cells from step 7 and 9 into one tube.

steps.title: Prepare Base Buffer
steps.instruction: Make and/or warm Base Buffer 1 to 37 °C.

steps.title: Document and Prepare Samples
steps.instruction: Pour the sample(s) into a 10cm dish and take a picture of the samples in the media they arrived in.

steps.title: Tissue Digestion
steps.instruction: Cut sample into small pieces and place into a 1.5mL tube (or multiple tubes if necessary, avoiding overloading).

substeps.instruction: Add 1.5 mL of collagenase buffer 2.
Digest for 00:30:00 at 37 °C, shaking in a thermomixer at 800-1000 rpm (ensure tissue is not sitting at the bottom).
If chunks remain, pipet the sample up and down 15 times and return to the thermomixer for another 00:30:00 at 37 °C shaking.

steps.title: Mechanical Dissociation
steps.instruction: Remove the sample from the thermomixer and pipet the sample up and down 15 times.

steps.title: Filter and Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Filter the sample through a 100-micron filter into a new 1.5 mL tube.

substeps.instruction: Wash the sample filter with 1-2mL of collagenase buffer.
Place the cells that passed through the filter on ice.

steps.title: Initial Cell Viability Check
steps.instruction: Check cells using Trypan Blue and a Hemocytometer (mix 10ul Trypan blue with 10ul of sample).

substeps.instruction: Take a microscope picture.
Label with date and sample ID.
Record the number of live and dead cells.

steps.title: Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Spin the sample at 1500 rpm for 00:10:00.

steps.title: Optional RBC Lysis
steps.instruction: If the pellet is visibly red, perform RBC lysis.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 mLs RBC lysis buffer to sample tubes.
Leave at room temperature (RT) for 2-5min.
Add 1.0 mL DMEM F12 + 6% FBS to each tube and spin again.

steps.title: Resuspension
steps.instruction: Aspirate off the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 120 uL of FACS Buffer 3.

steps.title: Final Cell Count
steps.instruction: Count cells using Trypan Blue and a hemocytometer (mix 10ul Trypan blue with 10ul of sample).

substeps.instruction: Record the number of live and dead (stained blue) cells.
Take a microscope picture labeled with date, sample ID, and 'final'.

steps.title: Prepare Unstained Control
steps.instruction: Remove 10ul of sample into a new 1.5mL tube, add 350uL of FACS Buffer, and set aside as an unstained control.

steps.title: Cell Staining
steps.instruction: Stain the remaining cells and incubate on ice in the dark for 00:20:00.

substeps.instruction: Add 10ul CD45-FITC (if cell count is under 1x10^7).
Add 1ul of Hoechst stain (diluted 1:10).

steps.title: Wash Stained Cells
steps.instruction: Wash the stained cells to remove excess dye.

substeps.instruction: Add 1mL of FACS Buffer to stained cells.
Spin at 1500 rpm for 00:10:00 and aspirate off supernatant.
Resuspend with 0.5 mLs of FACS Buffer.

steps.title: Final Preparation for Sorting
steps.instruction: Prepare samples for the FACS machine.

substeps.instruction: 00:05:00 before sorting, add 0.5 uL of PI and mix well.
Transfer unstained and stained samples to FACS tubes and leave on ice in the dark.
